rows.text: Whoa... Thank you so much! Finally, another visitor here after all this time.
rows.speaker: Priest Bug

rows.text: This place used to be a holy site where Titans delivered prophesies and alliances discussed matters of importance.
rows.speaker: Priest Bug

rows.text: But unfortunately, the holy site was destroyed, and now there's just a stark silence hanging in the air. No longer may the voices of the gods be heard...
rows.speaker: Priest Bug

rows.text: Darn it, how have I been buried again? Quick, dig me up and save me!
rows.speaker: Priest Bug
